category_title: Students who respond to microaggressions with silence or passivity
minimal_context: Julian is standing at the whiteboard in front of the whole class, tasked with reading and pronouncing the word criticism.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Julian, please read the word 'criticism' on the whiteboard for the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans against the whiteboard) I don't know.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to sound it out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Stop saying I don't know, say the word!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Julian, please read the word 'criticism' on the whiteboard for the class.

STUDENT: (Leans against the whiteboard) I don't know.

TUTOR: Just try to sound it out.

STUDENT: I don't know.

TUTOR: Stop saying I don't know, say the word!

STUDENT: crit –goddamn!

task.content: Reading and pronunciation of the word criticism

context.environment: In front of the rest of the class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher yelled at him, 'stop saying I don't know, say the word!'

behavior_patterns.condition: When struggling with the reading and pronunciation of the word in front of the class
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Leaning against the whiteboard, repeatedly told the teacher, 'I don't know.'
